notes: Item 19 is well-disclosed with three charts. Chart 1: Same-store sales growth for 377 franchised restaurants over FY2022-2024. Chart 2: Quartile breakdown for 444 franchised restaurants for trailing 12 months ended 9/29/2024. Chart 3: Detailed P&L including EBITDA for 318 franchised restaurants for trailing 12 months. One minor footnote discrepancy: footnote (3) in the source document labels FY 2024 data as 'FY 2023' — this appears to be a typographical error in the document; the date range (10/2/2023-9/29/2024) confirms it is FY 2024. The 'Add Back Royalty Fee' and 'Add Back Advertising Fee' rows in Chart 3 are reconciliation items, not separate cohort metrics, so they are not extracted as standalone records. Values extracted for Salaries and Benefits are dollar amounts, though schema metric_name 'labor_pct' was used for categorization.
